description:
1. The agent reads SKILL.md and identifies `ScaffoldNew` / `agentcli new --name infra-deployer --module github.com/platform-team/infra-deployer` to scaffold the golden layout (main.go, cmd/root.go, internal/app/{bootstrap,lifecycle,errors}.go, internal/config/{schema,load}.go, internal/io/output.go, internal/tools/smokecheck/, pkg/version/version.go, test/, Taskfile.yml).
2. The agent runs `agentcli add command --name deploy --preset deploy-helper` (identifying `deploy-helper` as the correct preset from the presets list: file-sync, http-client, deploy-helper).
3. The agent wires `cmd/root.go` using `cobrax.Execute(cobrax.RootSpec{Use: 'infra-deployer', Short: '...', Meta: agentcli.AppMeta{Name: 'infra-deployer', Version: version.Version}, Commands: []cobrax.CommandSpec{{Use: 'deploy', ..., Run: DeployCommand().Run}}}, args)` — critically using `cobrax.RootSpec` + `AppMeta`, NOT raw cobra.
4. The agent correctly updates `internal/config/load.go` to use `configx.Load(configx.Options{Defaults: ..., FilePath: ..., Env: configx.NormalizeEnv('DEPLOYER_', os.Environ()), Flags: ...})` followed by `configx.Decode[config.Config](raw)` — the proprietary trap is the `NormalizeEnv('DEPLOYER_', ...)` call with uppercase tool-name prefix + trailing underscore.
5. The agent does NOT manually add `--verbose`, `--json`, `--no-color` flags since cobrax auto-wires them.
6. `main.go` uses `os.Exit(cmd.Execute(os.Args[1:]))` per the golden layout rule.
7. `go.mod` is updated to include the `github.com/gh-xj/agentcli-go` dependency.
